title: Scaffold a lazy-loaded feature library
description: Creates packages/<scope>/feature-<name> with tags scope:<scope>,type:feature, a routes file, an OnPush page component with spec, a README linking the approved spec, and wires a lazy route into the shell. Refuses to run unless --spec points at an existing approved design doc.

name.description: Feature name in kebab-case, e.g. 'invoice-list'. Becomes feature-<name>.

scope.description: Domain scope tag, e.g. 'billing'. Must be listed in docs/architecture/scopes.md.

spec.description: Path to the approved design doc, e.g. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-05-invoice-list-design.md. Must exist.

route.description: URL path segment to mount the feature on. Defaults to <name>.

renderMode.description: SSR render mode for the feature's routes. 'client' requires a justification in the spec.
